verdict.rationale: RevenueCat publishes official SDKs, including the open-source purchases-ios repo for fetching products, making purchases and checking subscription status. Its docs cover concrete SDK methods such as `purchase(package:)` across Apple, Google and Amazon, `getCustomerInfo()` and intro-offer eligibility checks, plus a Web SDK for web billing with RevenueCat, Stripe and Paddle. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and direct evidence of the non-iOS native SDK repos (e.g., Android or cross-platform frameworks) beyond the iOS repo and Web SDK docs.
